title: RAW_UNSCREENED: chckhy als Geschwindigkeitsmodifier oder Materialeigenschaft
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: chckhy occurs beside lchal in f111v.17 and in the distinct f80r.14 line.

design.scope_description: Only already exposed source lines and cached report outputs; no new selectors, images or reserves.
design.mechanism: Adverb reading modifies a motion/process; property reading describes a material or record item.
design.unit: Exact whole-form occurrences at the named loci.
design.prediction: Adverb predicts a written event predicate in both contexts; property predicts compatible nominal/state fields without motion.
concrete_observations: GDT939 records exact chckhy in f111v.17 and f80r.14; f111v.17 also contains lchal, while f80r.14 has several state/value forms.
linked_consequences: Event use requires an action-bearing neighbor; property use requires a stable nominal host or state field.
design.distinguishing_observation: Audit exact host and action/result classes in both lines and cached controls; do not score the translated adverb.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The two contexts may differ only because ordinary modifiers occur in mixed prose.
